_comment: Model slot per harness step. 'tier' says how strong a model the step needs. Only the planner calls a model; everything else is deterministic code. Paid third-party adapters stay disabled until a human flips 'enabled' (we trial them later, never by default).

plan.why: story cut + beat/scene design + custom SVG drawing: taste, literal mapping words->objects, novelty vs memory

repair.why: JSON schema repair is done in code (planner.validate); a cheap model is only a fallback

vision.why: OpenCV Haar faces + histogram shot cuts

qc.why: frame metrics, danger zones, loudness are measured in code

claude.note: Claude Code CLI `claude -p` (empty model = the CLI default). Set e.g. a faster model id here to trade taste for speed.

local.note: no model; keyword heuristics + seeded variety; ~0.1 s; use for dry runs and timing

openrouter.note: OpenRouter (any model id, e.g. openai/gpt-6.2-sol, google/gemini-4-carbon). Key read in code from key_file only, never in git. No response_format json_object (gemini-4-carbon failed with it + max_tokens 16000; plain call + 32000 worked). Invalid JSON -> local repair -> one model retry.
